def fit_image(
    img,
    w=360,
    h=240
):
    canvas = np.full(
        (h, w, 3),
        255,
        dtype=np.uint8
    )

    ih, iw = img.shape[:2]

    scale = min(
        w / iw,
        h / ih
    )

    nw = max(
        1,
        int(iw * scale)
    )

    nh = max(
        1,
        int(ih * scale)
    )

    im = cv2.resize(
        img,
        (nw, nh)
    )

    x = (w - nw) // 2
    y = (h - nh) // 2

    canvas[
        y:y+nh,
        x:x+nw
    ] = im

    return canvas

    height=240
):

    canvas = np.zeros(

    canvas[

# ============================================================
# Image resolver
# ============================================================

sequence_cache = {}


def get_sequence_images(
    sequence
):
    if sequence in sequence_cache:
        return sequence_cache[
            sequence
        ]

    folder = (
        IMAGE_ROOT /
        sequence
    )

    if not folder.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Sequence image folder missing: {folder}"
        )

    images = []

    for ext in [
        "*.jpg",
        "*.jpeg",
        "*.png",
        "*.JPG",
        "*.JPEG",
        "*.PNG",
    ]:
        images.extend(
            folder.glob(ext)
        )

    images = sorted(
        set(images)
    )

    if not images:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"No images found: {folder}"
        )

    sequence_cache[
        sequence
    ] = images

    return images


def resolve_image(
    row
):
    # Prefer an explicit path if one exists.
    for col in [
        "image_path",
        "rgb_path",
        "frame_path",
    ]:
        if col in row.index:

            value = row[col]

            if pd.notna(value):

                path = Path(
                    str(value)
                )

                if not path.is_absolute():
                    path = (
                        ROOT /
                        path
                    )

                if path.exists():
                    return path


    # 3DPW frame/annotation alignment was already verified.
    # Therefore use original frame_index into the ordered
    # sequence image list as the robust fallback.
    sequence = str(
        row[
            "sequence"
        ]
    )

    frame_index = int(
        row[
            "frame_index"
        ]
    )

    images = get_sequence_images(
        sequence
    )

    if (
        frame_index < 0
        or
        frame_index >= len(images)
    ):
        raise IndexError(
            f"{sequence}: frame_index={frame_index}, "
            f"but only {len(images)} RGB frames."
        )

    return images[
        frame_index
    ]


# ============================================================
# Person crop
# ============================================================

def person_crop(
    image,
    descriptor_index
):
    descriptor_index = int(
        descriptor_index
    )

    center = center_xy_all[
        descriptor_index
    ].astype(
        np.float64
    )

    scale = float(
        torso_scale_all[
            descriptor_index
        ]
    )

    w, h = image.size


    if (
        not np.all(
            np.isfinite(
                center
            )
        )
        or
        not np.isfinite(
            scale
        )
        or
        scale <= 0
    ):
        return image.copy()


    cx = float(
        center[0]
    )

    cy = float(
        center[1]
    )


    # torso_scale is derived from body geometry.
    # 6x gives enough context for most full-body subjects.
    side = float(
        np.clip(
            6.0 * scale,
            256.0,
            900.0
        )
    )


    half = (
        side / 2.0
    )


    left = int(
        round(
            cx - half
        )
    )

    top = int(
        round(
            cy - half
        )
    )

    right = int(
        round(
            cx + half
        )
    )

    bottom = int(
        round(
            cy + half
        )
    )


    # Add white padding if the person crop reaches image border.
    pad_left = max(
        0,
        -left
    )

    pad_top = max(
        0,
        -top
    )

    pad_right = max(
        0,
        right - w
    )

    pad_bottom = max(
        0,
        bottom - h
    )


    if any(
        [
            pad_left,
            pad_top,
            pad_right,
            pad_bottom,
        ]
    ):
        image = ImageOps.expand(
            image,
            border=(
                pad_left,
                pad_top,
                pad_right,
                pad_bottom
            ),
            fill="white"
        )

        left += pad_left
        right += pad_left

        top += pad_top
        bottom += pad_top


    return image.crop(
        (
            left,
            top,
            right,
            bottom,
        )
    )

def make_contain(
    image,
    size
):
    canvas = Image.new(
        "RGB",
        size,
        "white"
    )

    fitted = ImageOps.contain(
        image,
        size
    )

    x = (
        size[0]
        -
        fitted.width
    ) // 2

    y = (
        size[1]
        -
        fitted.height
    ) // 2


    canvas.paste(
        fitted,
        (
            x,
            y
        )
    )

    return canvas


def make_crop_thumb(

):
    return ImageOps.fit(
        image,
        (

        ),
        method=Image.Resampling.LANCZOS
    )

import os
import glob
import pickle
import json
import pandas as pd


ROOT = "outputs/3dpw_assets_v2_1"
SRC_SEQ = "data/3DPW/sequenceFiles"

IN_CSV = os.path.join(
    ROOT,
    "frame_quality_with_status_v1.csv"
)

OUT_ALL = os.path.join(
    ROOT,
    "frame_quality_with_status_v1_1.csv"
)

OUT_USABLE = os.path.join(
    ROOT,
    "usable_frames_v1_1.csv"
)

OUT_CLEAN = os.path.join(
    ROOT,
    "clean_frames_v1_1.csv"
)

OUT_RISK = os.path.join(
    ROOT,
    "risk_frames_v1_1.csv"
)

OUT_REJECT = os.path.join(
    ROOT,
    "rejected_frames_v1_1.csv"
)

OUT_SUMMARY = os.path.join(
    ROOT,
    "usable_frames_v1_1_summary.json"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. 从官方3DPW PKL读取每个sequence的tracked-person数量
# ------------------------------------------------------------

seq_person_count = {}

for split in [
    "train",
    "validation",
    "test"
]:
    pkl_dir = os.path.join(
        SRC_SEQ,
        split
    )

    for pkl_path in glob.glob(
        os.path.join(
            pkl_dir,
            "*.pkl"
        )
    ):
        with open(
            pkl_path,
            "rb"
        ) as f:
            data = pickle.load(
                f,
                encoding="latin1"
            )

        seq = data["sequence"]

        seq_person_count[
            (split, seq)
        ] = len(
            data["poses"]
        )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. 加入official tracked people
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df = pd.read_csv(
    IN_CSV
)

df["official_tracked_people"] = [
    seq_person_count[
        (split, seq)
    ]
    for split, seq
    in zip(
        df["split"],
        df["sequence"]
    )
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. 修正多人风险
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df["official_multi_person_risk"] = (
    df["official_tracked_people"] > 1
)

df["detected_multi_person_risk"] = (
    df["person_count"] > 1
)

df["multi_person_risk"] = (
    df["official_multi_person_risk"]
    |
    df["detected_multi_person_risk"]
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. 重算soft risk
# ------------------------------------------------------------

risk_cols = [
    "multi_person_risk",
    "border_risk_flag",
    "low_visibility_risk",
    "blur_risk",
    "low_head_quality_risk",
]

df["soft_risk"] = (
    df[risk_cols]
    .any(axis=1)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. 重算quality status
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df["quality_status"] = "clean"

df.loc[
    (~df["hard_reject"])
    &
    (df["soft_risk"]),
    "quality_status"
] = "risk"

df.loc[
    df["hard_reject"],
    "quality_status"
] = "reject"


usable = df.loc[
    ~df["hard_reject"]
].copy()

clean = df.loc[
    df["quality_status"] == "clean"
].copy()

risk = df.loc[
    df["quality_status"] == "risk"
].copy()

reject = df.loc[
    df["quality_status"] == "reject"
].copy()


df.to_csv(
    OUT_ALL,
    index=False
)

usable.to_csv(
    OUT_USABLE,
    index=False
)

clean.to_csv(
    OUT_CLEAN,
    index=False
)

risk.to_csv(
    OUT_RISK,
    index=False
)

reject.to_csv(
    OUT_REJECT,
    index=False
)


summary = {
    "input_frames": int(len(df)),
    "usable_frames": int(len(usable)),
    "clean_frames": int(len(clean)),
    "risk_frames": int(len(risk)),
    "reject_frames": int(len(reject)),

    "official_single_person_frames":
        int(
            (
                df["official_tracked_people"] == 1
            ).sum()
        ),

    "official_multi_person_frames":
        int(
            (
                df["official_tracked_people"] > 1
            ).sum()
        ),

    "usable_official_multi_person":
        int(
            usable[
                "official_multi_person_risk"
            ].sum()
        ),

    "usable_detected_multi_person":
        int(
            usable[
                "detected_multi_person_risk"
            ].sum()
        ),

    "usable_any_multi_person":
        int(
            usable[
                "multi_person_risk"
            ].sum()
        ),
}


with open(
    OUT_SUMMARY,
    "w",
    encoding="utf-8"
) as f:

    json.dump(
        summary,
        f,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2
    )


print("=" * 80)
print("3DPW Usable Frames v1.1")
print("=" * 80)

print("Input :", len(df))
print("Usable:", len(usable))
print("Clean :", len(clean))
print("Risk  :", len(risk))
print("Reject:", len(reject))

print()
print("Official tracked people:")
print(
    df["official_tracked_people"]
    .value_counts()
    .sort_index()
)

print()
print("Usable multi-person risks:")
print(
    "official:",
    int(
        usable[
            "official_multi_person_risk"
        ].sum()
    )
)

print(
    "YOLO:",
    int(
        usable[
            "detected_multi_person_risk"
        ].sum()
    )
)

print(
    "either:",
    int(
        usable[
            "multi_person_risk"
        ].sum()
    )
)

print()
print("Clean split:")
print(
    clean[
        "split"
    ].value_counts()
)

print()

import os
import cv2
import pandas as pd


CSV = "outputs/3dpw_pair/pair_quality_v3.csv"
OUT = "outputs/3dpw_v3_review"

os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

df = pd.read_csv(CSV)


def resize_keep(img, height=420):
    h, w = img.shape[:2]
    scale = height / h
    nw = int(w * scale)
    return cv2.resize(img, (nw, height))


def make_preview(row, path):

    src = cv2.imread(row["source_image_path"])
    tgt = cv2.imread(row["target_image_path"])

    if src is None or tgt is None:
        return False

    src = resize_keep(src)
    tgt = resize_keep(tgt)

    canvas = cv2.hconcat([src, tgt])

    info1 = (
        f"{row['sequence']} | "
        f"S:{row['source_frame_id']} "
        f"T:{row['target_frame_id']}"
    )

    info2 = (
        f"pose={row['pose_distance']:.2f} "
        f"cam={row['camera_distance']:.2f} "
        f"scale={row['scale_ratio']:.2f}"
    )

    info3 = (
        f"people={int(row['source_person_count'])}"
        f"/{int(row['target_person_count'])} "
        f"conf={row['conf_min']:.2f} "
        f"vis={int(row['source_visible_body_joints'])}"
        f"/{int(row['target_visible_body_joints'])}"
    )

    info4 = (
        f"border={int(row['source_border_touch'])}"
        f"/{int(row['target_border_touch'])} "
        f"occ={int(row['occlusion_risk'])} "
        f"keep={int(row['keep_v3'])}"
    )

    y = 30

    for text in [info1, info2, info3, info4]:

        cv2.putText(
            canvas,
            text,
            (15, y),
            cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,
            0.65,
            (0, 0, 255),
            2
        )

        y += 30

    cv2.imwrite(path, canvas)

    return True


def export_group(name, sub, n=50):

    out_dir = os.path.join(OUT, name)
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

    sub = sub.head(n).copy()

    manifest = []

    for i, (_, row) in enumerate(sub.iterrows()):

        path = os.path.join(
            out_dir,
            f"{i:03d}.jpg"
        )

        ok = make_preview(row, path)

        if ok:
            r = row.to_dict()
            r["preview_path"] = path
            manifest.append(r)

    pd.DataFrame(manifest).to_csv(
        os.path.join(out_dir, "manifest.csv"),
        index=False,
        encoding="utf-8-sig"
    )

    print(
        f"{name:30s}",
        len(manifest)
    )


# 1. 最值得看：
# 已经通过 hard filter，
# 但仍然具有遮挡风险
occ = df[
    (df["keep_v3"])
    &
    (df["occlusion_risk"])
].copy()

occ = occ.sort_values(
    [
        "visible_body_min",
        "visible_body_change"
    ],
    ascending=[
        True,
        False
    ]
)

export_group(
    "01_kept_occlusion_risk",
    occ,
    80
)


# 2. 明确多人
multi = df[
    df["multi_person_flag"]
].copy()

multi = multi.sort_values(
    [
        "source_person_count",
        "target_person_count"
    ],
    ascending=False
)

export_group(
    "02_multi_person",
    multi,
    50
)


# 3. 尺度变化最大
scale = df[
    df["scale_change_flag"]
].copy()

scale = scale.sort_values(
    "scale_ratio",
    ascending=False
)

export_group(

import os
import cv2
import pandas as pd


CSV = "outputs/3dpw_pair/pair_quality_v3.csv"
OUT = "outputs/3dpw_v3_review_balanced"

MAX_PER_SEQUENCE = 4
MIN_SOURCE_GAP = 60
MIN_TARGET_GAP = 60
TOTAL = 80

os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

df = pd.read_csv(CSV)


def resize_keep(img, height=420):
    h, w = img.shape[:2]
    scale = height / h
    return cv2.resize(
        img,
        (int(w * scale), height)
    )


def make_preview(row, path):

    src = cv2.imread(row["source_image_path"])
    tgt = cv2.imread(row["target_image_path"])

    if src is None or tgt is None:
        return False

    src = resize_keep(src)
    tgt = resize_keep(tgt)

    canvas = cv2.hconcat([src, tgt])

    texts = [
        (
            f"{row['sequence']} | "
            f"S:{row['source_frame_id']} "
            f"T:{row['target_frame_id']}"
        ),
        (
            f"pose={row['pose_distance']:.2f} "
            f"cam={row['camera_distance']:.2f} "
            f"scale={row['scale_ratio']:.2f}"
        ),
        (
            f"people={int(row['source_person_count'])}/"
            f"{int(row['target_person_count'])} "
            f"conf={row['conf_min']:.2f} "
            f"vis={int(row['source_visible_body_joints'])}/"
            f"{int(row['target_visible_body_joints'])}"
        ),
        (
            f"border={int(row['source_border_touch'])}/"
            f"{int(row['target_border_touch'])} "
            f"occ={int(row['occlusion_risk'])}"
        )
    ]

    y = 28

    for text in texts:
        cv2.putText(
            canvas,
            text,
            (15, y),
            cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,
            0.62,
            (0, 0, 255),
            2
        )
        y += 28

    cv2.imwrite(path, canvas)

    return True


def diverse_select(df, total):

    df = df.sort_values(
        [
            "visible_body_min",
            "visible_body_change"
        ],
        ascending=[
            True,
            False
        ]
    )

    selected = []
    selected_by_seq = {}

    for _, row in df.iterrows():

        seq = row["sequence"]

        previous = selected_by_seq.get(seq, [])

        if len(previous) >= MAX_PER_SEQUENCE:
            continue

        too_close = False

        for old in previous:

            source_close = (
                abs(
                    int(row["source_frame_id"])
                    - int(old["source_frame_id"])
                )
                < MIN_SOURCE_GAP
            )

            target_close = (
                abs(
                    int(row["target_frame_id"])
                    - int(old["target_frame_id"])
                )
                < MIN_TARGET_GAP
            )

            if source_close and target_close:
                too_close = True
                break

        if too_close:
            continue

        d = row.to_dict()

        selected.append(d)

        selected_by_seq.setdefault(
            seq,
            []
        ).append(d)

        if len(selected) >= total:
            break

    return pd.DataFrame(selected)


occ = df[
    (df["keep_v3"])
    &
    (df["occlusion_risk"])
].copy()


selected = diverse_select(
    occ,
    TOTAL
)


print("Original risk pairs:", len(occ))
print("Selected preview:", len(selected))
print("Sequences:", selected["sequence"].nunique())

print()
print(
    selected["sequence"]
    .value_counts()
)


for i, (_, row) in enumerate(selected.iterrows()):

    path = os.path.join(
        OUT,
        f"{i:03d}.jpg"
    )

    make_preview(
        row,
        path
    )


selected.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUT,
        "manifest.csv"
    ),
    index=False,
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)


print()
print("Saved:")
print(OUT)

def tensor_to_pil(
    tensor,
):
    array = (
        tensor
        .detach()
        .cpu()
        .clamp(
            0,
            1
        )
        .permute(
            1,
            2,
            0
        )
        .numpy()
    )

    array = (
        array
        *
        255.0
    ).round().astype(
        np.uint8
    )


    return Image.fromarray(
        array
    )

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check target-RGB isolation and target-geometry sensitivity on one Hi4D source."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
from diffusers import QwenImage21Pipeline
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

from src.data.hi4d_qwen21_dataset import Hi4DQwen21Dataset
from src.pose_control.qwen21.action_prompts import build_dual_action_prompts
from src.pose_control.qwen21.dual_adapter import Qwen21DualAdapter
from src.pose_control.qwen21.dual_inference import generation_inputs_from_sample, generate_controlled
from src.pose_control.qwen21.runtime import Qwen21IPERCache
from train_hi4d_qwen21_dual import DUAL_TARGET_CACHE_NAMESPACE, ROOT


def args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--peak-pairs", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--alternate-pairs", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model", type=Path, default=ROOT / "models/Qwen-Image-2.1")
    parser.add_argument("--control-cache", type=Path, default=Path("/home/shangguanrz/nihaochen/qwen21_hi4d_controls"))
    parser.add_argument("--latent-cache", type=Path, default=Path("/home/shangguanrz/nihaochen/qwen21_hi4d_latents"))
    parser.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=40)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    return parser.parse_args()


def control_differences(a, b):
    changed = []
    for name in a:
        left, right = a[name], b[name]
        if torch.is_tensor(left) and not torch.equal(left, right):
            changed.append(name)
        elif name == "contact_relations":
            if any(not torch.equal(getattr(left, field), getattr(right, field))
                   for field in ("src_person", "src_part", "dst_person", "dst_part",
                                 "contact_type", "distance", "valid_mask")):
                changed.append(name)
    return changed


def main():
    config = args()
    config.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    peak = Hi4DQwen21Dataset(config.peak_pairs, config.control_cache, load_target=False)[0]
    alternate = Hi4DQwen21Dataset(config.alternate_pairs, config.control_cache, load_target=False)[0]
    assert peak["row"]["source_rgb"] == alternate["row"]["source_rgb"]
    assert "tgt_image" not in peak and "tgt_image" not in alternate
    assert torch.equal(peak["src_image"], alternate["src_image"])
    prompt = build_dual_action_prompts(peak["row"]["target_action"],
                                       (peak["source_mask_a"], peak["source_mask_b"]))
    alternate_prompt = build_dual_action_prompts(alternate["row"]["target_action"],
                                                 (alternate["source_mask_a"], alternate["source_mask_b"]))
    assert prompt == alternate_prompt, "geometry comparison must keep prompt fixed"
    _, baseline = generation_inputs_from_sample(peak, *prompt)

    # Inject fake ground truth fields in memory. The generation boundary must
    # discard them, including any target path in the metadata row.
    poisoned = dict(peak)
    poisoned["row"] = {**peak["row"], "target_rgb": "/tmp/fake_target_rgb.png",
                       "target_gt_person_mask_A": "/tmp/fake_gt_A.png",
                       "target_gt_person_mask_B": "/tmp/fake_gt_B.png"}
    poisoned["tgt_image"] = torch.full_like(peak["src_image"], -1)
    poisoned["gt_mask_A"] = torch.ones((1, 512, 512))
    poisoned["gt_mask_B"] = torch.zeros((1, 512, 512))
    _, replaced = generation_inputs_from_sample(poisoned, *prompt)
    assert np.array_equal(np.asarray(baseline.source_image), np.asarray(replaced.source_image))
    assert not control_differences(baseline.controls, replaced.controls)
    _, switched = generation_inputs_from_sample(alternate, *alternate_prompt)
    changed_controls = control_differences(baseline.controls, switched.controls)
    assert changed_controls, "alternate target frame did not change the control tensors"

    saved = torch.load(config.checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False, mmap=True)
    pipe = QwenImage21Pipeline.from_pretrained(str(config.model), dtype=torch.bfloat16).to("cuda")
    pipe.set_progress_bar_config(disable=True)
    pipe.transformer.eval().requires_grad_(False)
    adapter = Qwen21DualAdapter().to(device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
    adapter.load_state_dict(saved["adapter_state_dict"])
    adapter.eval()
    cache = Qwen21IPERCache(config.latent_cache, prompt=DUAL_TARGET_CACHE_NAMESPACE)
    base_image = generate_controlled(pipe, adapter, cache, baseline,
                                     mode="full", steps=config.steps, seed=config.seed)
    replaced_image = generate_controlled(pipe, adapter, cache, replaced,
                                         mode="full", steps=config.steps, seed=config.seed)
    alternate_image = generate_controlled(pipe, adapter, cache, switched,
                                          mode="full", steps=config.steps, seed=config.seed)
    base_array = np.asarray(base_image)
    replaced_array = np.asarray(replaced_image)
    alternate_array = np.asarray(alternate_image)
    equal = bool(np.array_equal(base_array, replaced_array))
    geometry_mae = float(np.abs(base_array.astype(np.float32) - alternate_array).mean())
    base_image.save(config.output / "frame62_baseline.png")
    replaced_image.save(config.output / "frame62_replaced_gt.png")
    alternate_image.save(config.output / "frame34_geometry.png")
    panel = Image.new("RGB", (1024, 544), (30, 30, 30))
    for index, (image, caption) in enumerate(((base_image, "frame62 target geometry"),
                                               (alternate_image, "frame34 target geometry"))):
        panel.paste(image, (index * 512, 32))
        ImageDraw.Draw(panel).text((index * 512 + 8, 8), caption, fill="white")
    panel.save(config.output / "geometry_switch_panel.png")
    report = {"source": peak["row"]["source_rgb"], "prompt": prompt[1],
              "checkpoint": str(config.checkpoint), "seed": config.seed, "steps": config.steps,
              "target_rgb_loaded_for_generation": False,
              "target_rgb_and_gt_mask_replacement_pixel_equal": equal,
              "target_rgb_and_gt_mask_replacement_max_abs_diff": int(np.abs(base_array.astype(np.int16) - replaced_array).max()),
              "changed_control_names": changed_controls,
              "geometry_switch_output_mae": geometry_mae,
              "geometry_switch_output_pixel_equal": bool(np.array_equal(base_array, alternate_array))}
    (config.output / "audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2), flush=True)
    if not equal or geometry_mae <= 0:
        raise AssertionError("target isolation or geometry sensitivity audit failed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def read_jsonl(path):
    return [
        json.loads(x)
        for x in path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        ).splitlines()
        if x.strip()
    ]


def read_gray(path):
    img = cv2.imread(
        str(path),
        cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE,
    )

    if img is None:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"failed to read: {path}"
        )

    return img


def load_binary_mask(path, shape):
    mask = cv2.imread(
        str(path),
        cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE,
    )

    if mask is None:
        return np.ones(
            shape,
            dtype=np.uint8,
        )

    if mask.shape != shape:
        mask = cv2.resize(
            mask,
            (shape[1], shape[0]),
            interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST,
        )

    return (
        mask > 20
    ).astype(np.uint8)


def sharpness_scores(rgb_path, mask_path):
    """
    返回：
    1. whole-image Laplacian variance
    2. person-region Laplacian variance

    person-region 更重要，因为背景本身可能虚化。
    """

    gray = read_gray(rgb_path)

    mask = load_binary_mask(
        mask_path,
        gray.shape,
    )

    lap = cv2.Laplacian(
        gray,
        cv2.CV_64F,
    )

    whole_score = float(
        lap.var()
    )

    person_pixels = (
        lap[mask > 0]
    )

    if person_pixels.size < 100:
        person_score = whole_score
    else:
        person_score = float(
            person_pixels.var()
        )

    return (
        whole_score,
        person_score,
    )


def make_panel(row):
    rgb = cv2.imread(
        row["rgb"]
    )

    pose = cv2.imread(
        row["dwpose_png"]
    )

    if rgb is None:
        return None

    H, W = rgb.shape[:2]

    if pose is None:
        pose = np.zeros_like(
            rgb
        )
    elif pose.shape[:2] != (H, W):
        pose = cv2.resize(
            pose,
            (W, H),
            interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,
        )

    overlay = cv2.addWeighted(
        rgb,
        0.68,
        pose,
        0.85,
        0,
    )

    target_h = 320

    scale = (
        target_h / H
    )

    target_w = max(
        1,
        int(W * scale),
    )

    rgb_small = cv2.resize(
        rgb,
        (target_w, target_h),
        interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA,
    )

    overlay_small = cv2.resize(
        overlay,
        (target_w, target_h),
        interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA,
    )

    panel = np.concatenate(
        [
            rgb_small,
            overlay_small,
        ],
        axis=1,
    )

    cv2.rectangle(
        panel,
        (0, 0),
        (
            panel.shape[1],
            34,
        ),
        (0, 0, 0),
        -1,
    )

    text = (
        f"{row['split']} "
        f"{row['sequence_id']}/{row['stem']}  "
        f"personSharp={row['person_sharpness']:.1f}"
    )

    cv2.putText(
        panel,
        text,
        (5, 23),
        cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,
        0.48,
        (255, 255, 255),
        1,
        cv2.LINE_AA,
    )

    return panel


def save_sheet(rows, out_path):
    panels = []

    for row in rows:
        p = make_panel(row)

        if p is not None:
            panels.append(p)

    if not panels:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "no panels"
        )

    max_w = max(
        p.shape[1]
        for p in panels
    )

    max_h = max(
        p.shape[0]
        for p in panels
    )

    fixed = []

    for p in panels:
        canvas = np.zeros(
            (
                max_h,
                max_w,
                3,
            ),
            dtype=np.uint8,
        )

        canvas[
            :p.shape[0],
            :p.shape[1],
        ] = p

        fixed.append(
            canvas
        )

    cols = 4

    rows_out = []

    for i in range(
        0,
        len(fixed),
        cols,
    ):
        chunk = fixed[
            i:i + cols
        ]

        while (
            len(chunk)
            < cols
        ):
            chunk.append(
                np.zeros_like(
                    fixed[0]
                )
            )

        rows_out.append(
            np.concatenate(
                chunk,
                axis=1,
            )
        )

    sheet = np.concatenate(
        rows_out,
        axis=0,
    )

    cv2.imwrite(
        str(out_path),
        sheet,
    )


def main():
    OUT_ROOT.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    rows = read_jsonl(
        MANIFEST
    )

    scored = []

    for i, row in enumerate(
        rows,
        1,
    ):
        whole, person = (
            sharpness_scores(
                row["rgb"],
                row["person_mask"],
            )
        )

        x = dict(row)

        x[
            "whole_sharpness"
        ] = whole

        x[
            "person_sharpness"
        ] = person

        scored.append(
            x
        )

        if i % 1000 == 0:
            print(
                f"{i}/{len(rows)}",
                flush=True,
            )

    vals = np.array(
        [
            r["person_sharpness"]
            for r in scored
        ],
        dtype=np.float64,
    )

    print()
    print("=" * 76)
    print(
        "FINAL TIKTOK PERSON SHARPNESS"
    )
    print("=" * 76)

    print(
        "frames:",
        len(vals),
    )

    for q in [
        0.00,
        0.01,
        0.02,
        0.05,
        0.10,
        0.25,
        0.50,
        0.75,
        0.90,
        0.95,
        0.99,
        1.00,
    ]:
        print(
            f"q{q:4.2f}: "
            f"{np.quantile(vals, q):.3f}"
        )

    # CSV
    with CSV_OUT.open(
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:
        f.write(
            "split,sequence_id,stem,"
            "whole_sharpness,person_sharpness,rgb\n"
        )

        for r in scored:
            f.write(
                f"{r['split']},"
                f"{r['sequence_id']},"
                f"{r['stem']},"
                f"{r['whole_sharpness']:.6f},"
                f"{r['person_sharpness']:.6f},"
                f"{r['rgb']}\n"
            )

    # ---------------------------
    # Random 24
    # ---------------------------

    rng = random.Random(
        SEED
    )

    random_rows = rng.sample(
        scored,
        min(
            N,
            len(scored),
        ),
    )

    save_sheet(
        random_rows,
        RANDOM_SHEET,
    )

    # ---------------------------

    # ---------------------------

    blurry_rows = sorted(

    )


if __name__ == "__main__":

def resize_h(img, h=300):
    if img is None:
        return np.zeros(
            (h, int(h * 0.65), 3),
            dtype=np.uint8,
        )

    H, W = img.shape[:2]

    scale = h / H

    return cv2.resize(
        img,
        (
            max(1, int(W * scale)),
            h,
        ),
        interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA,
    )


def fit_width(img, width):
    H, W = img.shape[:2]

    if W == width:
        return img

    if W > width:
        return cv2.resize(
            img,
            (width, H),
            interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA,
        )

    out = np.zeros(
        (H, width, 3),
        dtype=np.uint8,
    )

    x = (width - W) // 2

    out[:, x:x + W] = img

    return out

        resize_h(normal),
    ]

        x.shape[1]
        for x in views
    )

    views = [
        fit_width(
            x,
            cell_w,
        )
        for x in views
    ]

    strip = np.concatenate(
        views,
        axis=1,
    )

    header_h = 62

    panel = np.zeros(

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

import csv
import json
import math
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np


ROOT = Path("/home/shangguanrz/project/pic-edit")

MANIFEST = (
    ROOT
    / "datasets/TikTokDataset/TikTok_v3/manifests/"
      "usable_frame_pool_split.jsonl"
)

OUT_ROOT = (
    ROOT
    / "datasets/TikTokDataset/TikTok_v3/qc/"
      "visual_quality_v2"
)

CSV_OUT = (
    OUT_ROOT
    / "visual_quality_scores_v2.csv"
)

SUMMARY_OUT = (
    OUT_ROOT
    / "visual_quality_summary_v2.json"
)

HARD_JSONL = (
    OUT_ROOT
    / "hard_blur_candidates_32.jsonl"
)

SOURCE_JSONL = (
    OUT_ROOT
    / "source_blur_risk_candidates_32.jsonl"
)


# ============================================================
# Parameters
# ============================================================

N_AUDIT = 32

# only for candidate discovery, NOT final deletion threshold
SEQ_LOW_Q = 0.10

# current frame is much worse than temporal neighbors
RECOVERY_STRONG = 1.50
RECOVERY_VERY_STRONG = 1.80

FACE_SCORE_THR = 0.30

FACE_RESIZE = 128

MIN_PERSON_PIXELS = 200

SEED = 2026


# ============================================================
# Basic IO
# ============================================================

def read_jsonl(path):
    return [
        json.loads(x)
        for x in path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        ).splitlines()
        if x.strip()
    ]


def read_bgr(path):
    img = cv2.imread(
        str(path),
        cv2.IMREAD_COLOR,
    )

    return img


def read_mask(path, shape):
    mask = cv2.imread(
        str(path),
        cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE,
    )

    if mask is None:
        return None

    H, W = shape

    if mask.shape != (H, W):
        mask = cv2.resize(
            mask,
            (W, H),
            interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST,
        )

    return (
        mask > 20
    ).astype(np.uint8)


# ============================================================
# Edge-conditioned sharpness
# ============================================================

def edge_sharpness(
    bgr,
    mask=None,
):
    """
    Tenengrad-style strong-edge sharpness.

    Important:
    - first slightly suppress compression noise
    - calculate Sobel gradient
    - DO NOT average over all person pixels
    - only average the strongest 10% gradient responses

    Therefore a large flat/solid-color shirt does not
    automatically receive a very low score simply because
    most pixels contain no texture.
    """

    if bgr is None:
        return float("nan")

    gray = cv2.cvtColor(
        bgr,
        cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY,
    )

    gray = cv2.GaussianBlur(
        gray,
        (3, 3),
        0.8,
    )

    gx = cv2.Sobel(
        gray,
        cv2.CV_32F,
        1,
        0,
        ksize=3,
    )

    gy = cv2.Sobel(
        gray,
        cv2.CV_32F,
        0,
        1,
        ksize=3,
    )

    mag = cv2.magnitude(
        gx,
        gy,
    )

    if mask is None:
        vals = mag.reshape(-1)
    else:
        valid = (
            mask > 0
        )

        if int(valid.sum()) < MIN_PERSON_PIXELS:
            return float("nan")

        vals = mag[valid]

    vals = vals[
        np.isfinite(vals)
    ]

    if vals.size < 100:
        return float("nan")

    # ignore flat regions:
    # only strongest 10% edge responses
    q90 = float(
        np.quantile(
            vals,
            0.90,
        )
    )

    strong = vals[
        vals >= q90
    ]

    if strong.size < 20:
        return float(
            np.mean(vals)
        )

    # median of strong edges is less sensitive
    # to compression/noise spikes than max
    return float(
        np.median(strong)
    )


# ============================================================
# Face crop from saved DWPose
# ============================================================

def load_dwpose_face(row):
    p = Path(
        row["dwpose_json"]
    )

    if not p.is_file():
        return None

    obj = json.loads(
        p.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )

    kp = np.asarray(
        obj["keypoints_norm"],
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    score = np.asarray(
        obj["scores"],
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    # DWPose standardized face:
    # indices 24:92
    if (
        kp.shape[0] < 92
        or score.shape[0] < 92
    ):
        return None

    return (
        kp[24:92],
        score[24:92],
    )


def get_face_crop(
    bgr,
    row,
):
    if bgr is None:
        return None

    face = load_dwpose_face(
        row
    )

    if face is None:
        return None

    kp, score = face

    valid = (
        np.isfinite(kp).all(axis=1)
        &
        (score > FACE_SCORE_THR)
    )

    if int(valid.sum()) < 8:
        return None

    H, W = bgr.shape[:2]

    pts = kp[
        valid
    ].copy()

    pts[:, 0] *= W
    pts[:, 1] *= H

    x1 = float(
        pts[:, 0].min()
    )

    x2 = float(
        pts[:, 0].max()
    )

    y1 = float(
        pts[:, 1].min()
    )

    y2 = float(
        pts[:, 1].max()
    )

    bw = max(
        1.0,
        x2 - x1,
    )

    bh = max(
        1.0,
        y2 - y1,
    )

    # include hair/head contour around face landmarks
    padx = 0.35 * bw
    pady = 0.45 * bh

    x1 = max(
        0,
        int(x1 - padx),
    )

    x2 = min(
        W,
        int(x2 + padx),
    )

    y1 = max(
        0,
        int(y1 - pady),
    )

    y2 = min(
        H,
        int(y2 + pady),
    )

    if (
        x2 - x1 < 20
        or y2 - y1 < 20
    ):
        return None

    return bgr[
        y1:y2,
        x1:x2,
    ].copy()


def face_edge_sharpness(
    bgr,
    row,
):
    crop = get_face_crop(
        bgr,
        row,
    )

    if crop is None:
        return float("nan")

    # normalize face scale before computing sharpness
    crop = cv2.resize(
        crop,
        (
            FACE_RESIZE,
            FACE_RESIZE,
        ),
        interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,
    )

    return edge_sharpness(
        crop,
        mask=None,
    )

def build_dir_index(directory):
    directory = Path(
        directory
    )

    index = {}

    if not directory.is_dir():
        return index

    for p in directory.iterdir():
        if not p.is_file():
            continue

        try:
            n = int(
                p.stem
            )
        except ValueError:
            continue

        index[n] = p

    return index


def get_motion_class(row):
    """
    Preserve previously computed motion class if available.
    It is NOT used as a hard rejection rule.
    """

    for key in [
        "motion_class",
        "motion_type",
        "motion_level",
        "dynamic_class",
    ]:
        if key in row:
            return row[key]

    sampling = row.get(
        "sampling",
    )

    if isinstance(
        sampling,
        dict,
    ):
        for key in [
            "motion_class",
            "motion_type",
            "motion_level",
        ]:
            if key in sampling:
                return sampling[key]

    return None


# ============================================================
# Relative percentile
# ============================================================

def percentile_rank(
    value,
    sorted_values,
):
    if (
        not np.isfinite(value)
        or len(sorted_values) == 0
    ):
        return float("nan")

    if len(sorted_values) == 1:
        return 0.5

    left = int(
        np.searchsorted(
            sorted_values,
            value,
            side="left",
        )
    )

    right = int(
        np.searchsorted(
            sorted_values,
            value,
            side="right",
        )
    )

    avg_rank = (
        left
        +
        right
        -
        1
    ) / 2.0

    return float(
        avg_rank
        /
        (
            len(sorted_values)
            - 1
        )
    )

def resize_keep_height(
    img,
    h,
):
    if img is None:
        return np.zeros(
            (
                h,
                int(h * 0.65),
                3,
            ),
            dtype=np.uint8,
        )

    H, W = img.shape[:2]

    scale = (
        h / H
    )

    w = max(
        1,
        int(W * scale),
    )

    return cv2.resize(
        img,
        (w, h),
        interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA,
    )


def fit_width(
    img,
    width,
):
    H, W = img.shape[:2]

    if W == width:
        return img

    if W > width:
        return cv2.resize(
            img,
            (
                width,
                H,
            ),
            interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA,
        )

    canvas = np.zeros(
        (
            H,
            width,
            3,
        ),
        dtype=np.uint8,
    )

    x = (
        width - W
    ) // 2

    canvas[
        :,
        x:x + W,
    ] = img

    return canvas


def make_temporal_panel(
    record,
    image_indices,
):
    """
    previous frame | current | next frame

    Metric itself uses ±1/±2.
    Visual audit shows ±1 for fast inspection.
    """

    seq = record[
        "sequence_id"
    ]

    frame_num = int(
        record["_frame_num_int"]
    )

    idx = image_indices[
        seq
    ]

    prev_path = idx.get(
        frame_num - 1
    )

    next_path = idx.get(
        frame_num + 1
    )

    current = read_bgr(
        record["rgb"]
    )

    prev_img = (
        read_bgr(prev_path)
        if prev_path
        else None
    )

    next_img = (
        read_bgr(next_path)
        if next_path
        else None
    )

    H = 220

    p = resize_keep_height(
        prev_img,
        H,
    )

    c = resize_keep_height(
        current,
        H,
    )

    n = resize_keep_height(
        next_img,
        H,
    )

    cell_w = max(
        p.shape[1],
        c.shape[1],
        n.shape[1],
    )

    p = fit_width(
        p,
        cell_w,
    )

    c = fit_width(
        c,
        cell_w,
    )

    n = fit_width(
        n,
        cell_w,
    )

    strip = np.concatenate(
        [
            p,
            c,
            n,
        ],
        axis=1,
    )

    # mark current frame
    cv2.rectangle(
        strip,
        (
            cell_w,
            0,
        ),
        (
            2 * cell_w - 1,
            H - 1,
        ),
        (255, 255, 255),
        3,
    )

    title_h = 58

    canvas = np.zeros(
        (
            H + title_h,
            strip.shape[1],
            3,
        ),
        dtype=np.uint8,
    )

    canvas[
        title_h:,
        :
    ] = strip

    text1 = (
        f"{record['split']} "
        f"{seq}/{record['stem']}  "
        f"edge={record['edge_sharpness']:.1f}  "
        f"seqP={record['seq_sharpness_percentile']:.2f}"
    )

    rec = record[
        "temporal_recovery_ratio"
    ]

    text2 = (
        f"recover={rec:.2f}  "
        f"face={record['face_edge_sharpness']:.1f}  "
        f"motion={record.get('motion_class')}"
    )

    cv2.putText(
        canvas,
        text1,
        (5, 20),
        cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,
        0.42,
        (255, 255, 255),
        1,
        cv2.LINE_AA,
    )

    cv2.putText(
        canvas,
        text2,
        (5, 43),
        cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,
        0.42,
        (255, 255, 255),
        1,
        cv2.LINE_AA,
    )

    return canvas


def make_source_panel(
    record,
):
    bgr = read_bgr(
        record["rgb"]
    )

    face = get_face_crop(
        bgr,
        record,
    )

    H = 260

    full = resize_keep_height(

    )

    text2 = (
        f"faceP={record['face_seq_percentile']:.2f}  "
        f"edgeP={record['seq_sharpness_percentile']:.2f}  "
        f"recover={record['temporal_recovery_ratio']:.2f}"
    )

    cv2.putText(

def save_panels(
    records,
    out_prefix,
    panel_func,
):
    """
    16 candidates per sheet.
    For 32 candidates => two sheets.
    """

    PER_SHEET = 16
    COLS = 2

    output_paths = []

    for start in range(
        0,
        len(records),
        PER_SHEET,
    ):
        chunk = records[
            start:
            start + PER_SHEET
        ]

        panels = [
            panel_func(r)
            for r in chunk
        ]

        max_h = max(
            p.shape[0]
            for p in panels
        )

        max_w = max(
            p.shape[1]
            for p in panels
        )

        fixed = []

        for p in panels:
            canvas = np.zeros(
                (
                    max_h,
                    max_w,
                    3,
                ),
                dtype=np.uint8,
            )

            canvas[
                :p.shape[0],
                :p.shape[1],
            ] = p

            fixed.append(
                canvas
            )

        rows = []

        for i in range(
            0,
            len(fixed),
            COLS,
        ):
            row = fixed[
                i:i + COLS
            ]

            while len(row) < COLS:
                row.append(
                    np.zeros_like(
                        fixed[0]
                    )
                )

            rows.append(
                np.concatenate(
                    row,
                    axis=1,
                )
            )

        sheet = np.concatenate(
            rows,
            axis=0,
        )

        page = (
            start // PER_SHEET
            + 1
        )

        out = OUT_ROOT / (
            f"{out_prefix}_"
            f"{page:02d}.jpg"
        )

        cv2.imwrite(
            str(out),
            sheet,
            [
                cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY,
                92,
            ],
        )

        output_paths.append(
            str(out)
        )

    return output_paths

# Main

def main():

    OUT_ROOT.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    rows = read_jsonl(
        MANIFEST
    )

    print("=" * 78)
    print(
        "TikTok V3 Visual Quality Audit V2"
    )
    print("=" * 78)
    print(
        "input frames:",
        len(rows),
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Build sequence image/mask directory indices
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    by_seq = defaultdict(
        list
    )

    for r in rows:
        by_seq[
            r["sequence_id"]
        ].append(r)

    image_indices = {}
    mask_indices = {}

    for seq, seq_rows in by_seq.items():

        rgb_parent = Path(
            seq_rows[0]["rgb"]
        ).parent

        mask_parent = Path(
            seq_rows[0]["person_mask"]
        ).parent

        image_indices[
            seq
        ] = build_dir_index(
            rgb_parent
        )

        mask_indices[
            seq
        ] = build_dir_index(
            mask_parent
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Cache because neighbor frames overlap heavily
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    edge_cache = {}

    def raw_frame_edge(
        seq,
        frame_num,
    ):
        key = (
            seq,
            int(frame_num),
        )

        if key in edge_cache:
            return edge_cache[
                key
            ]

        ipath = image_indices[
            seq
        ].get(
            int(frame_num)
        )

        mpath = mask_indices[
            seq
        ].get(
            int(frame_num)
        )

        if ipath is None:
            edge_cache[
                key
            ] = float(
                "nan"
            )
            return edge_cache[
                key
            ]

        bgr = read_bgr(
            ipath
        )

        if bgr is None:
            edge_cache[
                key
            ] = float(
                "nan"
            )
            return edge_cache[
                key
            ]

        H, W = bgr.shape[:2]

        mask = (
            read_mask(
                mpath,
                (H, W),
            )
            if mpath is not None
            else None
        )

        score = edge_sharpness(
            bgr,
            mask,
        )

        edge_cache[
            key
        ] = score

        return score

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Score current usable frames + temporal neighbors
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    scored = []

    for i, r in enumerate(
        rows,
        1,
    ):

        x = dict(
            r
        )

        try:
            frame_num = int(
                r["stem"]
            )
        except Exception:
            frame_num = int(
                r.get(
                    "frame_num",
                    -1,
                )
            )

        x[
            "_frame_num_int"
        ] = frame_num

        current_edge = raw_frame_edge(
            r["sequence_id"],
            frame_num,
        )

        bgr = read_bgr(
            r["rgb"]
        )

        face_edge = (
            face_edge_sharpness(
                bgr,
                r,
            )
            if bgr is not None
            else float("nan")
        )

        neighbor_scores = []

        for offset in [
            -2,
            -1,
            1,
            2,
        ]:
            s = raw_frame_edge(
                r["sequence_id"],
                frame_num + offset,
            )

            if np.isfinite(s):
                neighbor_scores.append(
                    float(s)
                )

        if (
            np.isfinite(
                current_edge
            )
            and current_edge > 1e-6
            and neighbor_scores
        ):
            # use the median of the best two temporal neighbors
            # instead of a single maximum spike
            best = sorted(
                neighbor_scores,
                reverse=True,
            )[:2]

            neighbor_reference = float(
                np.median(best)
            )

            recovery = (
                neighbor_reference
                /
                current_edge
            )
        else:
            neighbor_reference = float(
                "nan"
            )

            recovery = float(
                "nan"
            )

        x[
            "edge_sharpness"
        ] = float(
            current_edge
        )

        x[
            "face_edge_sharpness"
        ] = float(
            face_edge
        )

        x[
            "temporal_neighbor_reference"
        ] = float(
            neighbor_reference
        )

        x[
            "temporal_recovery_ratio"
        ] = float(
            recovery
        )

        x[
            "temporal_neighbor_count"
        ] = len(
            neighbor_scores
        )

        x[
            "motion_class"
        ] = get_motion_class(
            r
        )

        scored.append(
            x
        )

        if (
            i % 500 == 0
            or i == len(rows)
        ):
            print(
                f"{i}/{len(rows)}",
                flush=True,
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Sequence-relative percentiles
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    scored_by_seq = defaultdict(
        list
    )

    for r in scored:
        scored_by_seq[
            r["sequence_id"]
        ].append(r)

    for seq, seq_rows in scored_by_seq.items():

        sharp_vals = np.asarray(
            sorted(
                [
                    r["edge_sharpness"]
                    for r in seq_rows
                    if np.isfinite(
                        r["edge_sharpness"]
                    )
                ]
            ),
            dtype=np.float64,
        )

        face_vals = np.asarray(
            sorted(
                [
                    r["face_edge_sharpness"]
                    for r in seq_rows
                    if np.isfinite(
                        r["face_edge_sharpness"]
                    )
                ]
            ),
            dtype=np.float64,
        )

        for r in seq_rows:

            r[
                "sequence_usable_count"
            ] = len(
                seq_rows
            )

            r[
                "seq_sharpness_percentile"
            ] = percentile_rank(
                r[
                    "edge_sharpness"
                ],
                sharp_vals,
            )

            r[
                "face_seq_percentile"
            ] = percentile_rank(
                r[
                    "face_edge_sharpness"
                ],
                face_vals,
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Candidate labels
    #
    # IMPORTANT:
    # These labels are AUDIT CANDIDATES ONLY.
    # No frames are removed here.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    hard_candidates = []

    source_candidates = []

    for r in scored:

        p = r[
            "seq_sharpness_percentile"
        ]

        rec = r[
            "temporal_recovery_ratio"
        ]

        fp = r[
            "face_seq_percentile"
        ]

        seq_n = r[
            "sequence_usable_count"
        ]

        enough_seq = (
            seq_n >= 5
        )

        enough_neighbors = (
            r[
                "temporal_neighbor_count"
            ]
            >= 2
        )

        hard = False

        if (
            enough_neighbors
            and np.isfinite(rec)
        ):

            # very clear relative collapse
            if (
                rec
                >= RECOVERY_VERY_STRONG
            ):
                hard = True

            # sequence-low-tail + strong temporal recovery
            elif (
                enough_seq
                and
                np.isfinite(p)
                and
                p <= SEQ_LOW_Q
                and
                rec >= RECOVERY_STRONG
            ):
                hard = True

        r[
            "hard_blur_candidate"
        ] = bool(
            hard
        )

        # ranking score only
        hard_score = 0.0

        if np.isfinite(rec):
            hard_score += (
                max(
                    0.0,
                    rec - 1.0,
                )
                * 2.0
            )

        if np.isfinite(p):
            hard_score += (
                max(
                    0.0,
                    0.25 - p,
                )
                * 2.0
            )

        r[
            "hard_blur_suspicion_score"
        ] = float(
            hard_score
        )

        if hard:
            hard_candidates.append(
                r
            )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Source-only blur risk
        #
        # Not a target rejection rule.
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        source_risk = False

        if not hard:

            if (
                enough_seq
                and
                np.isfinite(fp)
                and
                fp <= 0.10
            ):
                source_risk = True

            elif (
                np.isfinite(p)
                and
                p <= 0.10
                and
                np.isfinite(rec)
                and
                rec >= 1.20
            ):
                source_risk = True

        r[
            "source_blur_risk_candidate"
        ] = bool(
            source_risk
        )

        source_score = 0.0

        if np.isfinite(fp):
            source_score += (
                1.0 - fp
            )

        if np.isfinite(p):
            source_score += (
                0.5
                *
                (
                    1.0 - p
                )
            )

        if np.isfinite(rec):
            source_score += (
                0.5
                *
                max(
                    0.0,
                    rec - 1.0,
                )
            )

        r[
            "source_blur_risk_score"
        ] = float(
            source_score
        )

        if source_risk:
            source_candidates.append(
                r
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Rank candidates
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    hard_ranked = sorted(
        hard_candidates,
        key=lambda r:
            r[
                "hard_blur_suspicion_score"
            ],
        reverse=True,
    )[
        :N_AUDIT
    ]

    source_ranked = sorted(
        source_candidates,
        key=lambda r:
            r[
                "source_blur_risk_score"
            ],
        reverse=True,
    )[
        :N_AUDIT
    ]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Save audit manifests
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def write_jsonl(
        path,
        items,
    ):
        with path.open(
            "w",
            encoding="utf-8",
        ) as f:
            for r in items:
                # remove only internal helper
                x = dict(
                    r
                )

                x.pop(
                    "_frame_num_int",
                    None,
                )

                f.write(
                    json.dumps(
                        x,
                        ensure_ascii=False,
                    )
                    + "\n"
                )

    write_jsonl(
        HARD_JSONL,
        hard_ranked,
    )

    write_jsonl(
        SOURCE_JSONL,
        source_ranked,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CSV
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    fields = [
        "split",
        "sequence_id",
        "stem",
        "motion_class",

        "edge_sharpness",
        "seq_sharpness_percentile",

        "temporal_neighbor_reference",
        "temporal_recovery_ratio",
        "temporal_neighbor_count",

        "face_edge_sharpness",
        "face_seq_percentile",

        "sequence_usable_count",

        "hard_blur_candidate",
        "hard_blur_suspicion_score",

        "source_blur_risk_candidate",
        "source_blur_risk_score",

        "rgb",
    ]

    with CSV_OUT.open(
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
        newline="",
    ) as f:

        writer = csv.DictWriter(
            f,
            fieldnames=fields,
        )

        writer.writeheader()

        for r in scored:

            writer.writerow({
                k: r.get(k)
                for k in fields
            })

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Contact sheets
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    hard_sheets = []

    if hard_ranked:
        hard_sheets = save_panels(
            hard_ranked,
            "hard_blur_temporal",
            lambda r:
                make_temporal_panel(
                    r,
                    image_indices,
                ),
        )

    source_sheets = []

    if source_ranked:
        source_sheets = save_panels(
            source_ranked,
            "source_blur_risk",
            make_source_panel,
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Summary
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    edges = np.asarray(
        [
            r[
                "edge_sharpness"
            ]
            for r in scored
            if np.isfinite(
                r[
                    "edge_sharpness"
                ]
            )
        ],

from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT

# ----------------- 样式辅助函数 -----------------

def set_run_font(run, name="微软雅黑", size=10, bold=False, color=(45, 55, 72), italic=False):
    run.font.name = name
    rPr = run._element.get_or_add_rPr()
    rFonts = rPr.get_or_add_rFonts()
    rFonts.set(qn('w:eastAsia'), name)
    rFonts.set(qn('w:ascii'), name)
    rFonts.set(qn('w:hAnsi'), name)
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.bold = bold
    run.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(*color)

def set_cell_background(cell, fill_hex):
    tcPr = cell._element.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement('w:shd')
    shd.set(qn('w:val'), 'clear')
    shd.set(qn('w:color'), 'auto')
    shd.set(qn('w:fill'), fill_hex)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def set_cell_margins(cell, top=100, bottom=100, left=120, right=120):
    tcPr = cell._element.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tcMar = OxmlElement('w:tcMar')
    for m, val in [('top', top), ('bottom', bottom), ('left', left), ('right', right)]:
        node = OxmlElement(f'w:{m}')
        node.set(qn('w:w'), str(val))
        node.set(qn('w:type'), 'dxa')
        tcMar.append(node)
    tcPr.append(tcMar)

def set_table_borders(table, color="CBD5E0", sz="4"):
    tblPr = table._element.xpath('w:tblPr')
    if tblPr:
        borders = OxmlElement('w:tblBorders')
        for b_name in ['top', 'left', 'bottom', 'right', 'insideH']:
            b = OxmlElement(f'w:{b_name}')
            b.set(qn('w:val'), 'single')
            b.set(qn('w:sz'), sz)
            b.set(qn('w:space'), '0')
            b.set(qn('w:color'), color)
            borders.append(b)
        insideV = OxmlElement('w:insideV')
        insideV.set(qn('w:val'), 'none')
        borders.append(insideV)
        tblPr[0].append(borders)

def add_sec_heading(doc, num_str, title_str):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(14)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)
    p.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True
    run_n = p.add_run(num_str + " ")
    set_run_font(run_n, name="微软雅黑", size=13, bold=True, color=(43, 108, 176))
    run_t = p.add_run(title_str)
    set_run_font(run_t, name="微软雅黑", size=13, bold=True, color=(26, 54, 93))
    return p

def add_body(doc, text, bold_p=None, space_after=4):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(space_after)
    p.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.2
    if bold_p:
        run_b = p.add_run(bold_p)
        set_run_font(run_b, name="微软雅黑", size=10, bold=True, color=(26, 54, 93))
    run = p.add_run(text)
    set_run_font(run, name="微软雅黑", size=10, bold=False, color=(45, 55, 72))
    return p

def add_bullet(doc, title, text):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style='List Bullet')
    p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(1)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    p.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.15
    run_t = p.add_run(title)
    set_run_font(run_t, name="微软雅黑", size=9.5, bold=True, color=(43, 108, 176))
    run = p.add_run(text)
    set_run_font(run, name="微软雅黑", size=9.5, bold=False, color=(45, 55, 72))
    return p

def add_summary_box(doc, text, title="分析核心结论", border_color="1A365D", bg_color="F0F4F8"):
    tbl = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    tbl.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    cell = tbl.cell(0, 0)
    set_cell_background(cell, bg_color)
    set_cell_margins(cell, top=100, bottom=100, left=150, right=150)
    
    tcPr = cell._element.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tcBorders = OxmlElement('w:tcBorders')
    left = OxmlElement('w:left')
    left.set(qn('w:val'), 'single')
    left.set(qn('w:sz'), '20')
    left.set(qn('w:space'), '0')
    left.set(qn('w:color'), border_color)
    tcBorders.append(left)
    for side in ['top', 'bottom', 'right']:
        b = OxmlElement(f'w:{side}')
        b.set(qn('w:val'), 'none')
        tcBorders.append(b)
    tcPr.append(tcBorders)

    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(1)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
    p.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.15
    if title:
        run_t = p.add_run(f"⚡ {title}：\n")
        set_run_font(run_t, name="微软雅黑", size=10, bold=True, color=(26, 54, 93))
    run = p.add_run(text)
    set_run_font(run, name="微软雅黑", size=9.5, bold=False, color=(45, 55, 72))
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)

def format_clean_table(table, col_widths, headers, data, align_cols=None):
    table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    set_table_borders(table)
    
    hdr_cells = table.rows[0].cells
    for i, title in enumerate(headers):
        hdr_cells[i].text = title
        set_cell_background(hdr_cells[i], "1A365D")
        set_cell_margins(hdr_cells[i], top=100, bottom=100, left=100, right=100)
        p = hdr_cells[i].paragraphs[0]
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
        p.runs[0].font.name = "微软雅黑"
        p.runs[0]._element.get_or_add_rPr().get_or_add_rFonts().set(qn('w:eastAsia'), "微软雅黑")
        p.runs[0].font.size = Pt(9.5)
        p.runs[0].bold = True
        p.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
        hdr_cells[i].width = col_widths[i]

    for r_idx, row_data in enumerate(data):
        row_cells = table.rows[r_idx + 1].cells
        bg_color = "F8FAFC" if r_idx % 2 == 1 else "FFFFFF"
        for c_idx, val in enumerate(row_data):
            row_cells[c_idx].text = str(val)
            set_cell_background(row_cells[c_idx], bg_color)
            set_cell_margins(row_cells[c_idx], top=80, bottom=80, left=100, right=100)
            p = row_cells[c_idx].paragraphs[0]
            if align_cols and c_idx in align_cols:
                p.alignment = align_cols[c_idx]
            else:
                p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
            if len(p.runs) > 0:
                p.runs[0].font.name = "微软雅黑"
                p.runs[0]._element.get_or_add_rPr().get_or_add_rFonts().set(qn('w:eastAsia'), "微软雅黑")
                p.runs[0].font.size = Pt(9)
                p.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(45, 55, 72)
            row_cells[c_idx].width = col_widths[c_idx]

# ----------------- 样式辅助函数 -----------------

def set_run_font(run, name="微软雅黑", size=10.5, bold=False, color=(45, 55, 72), italic=False):
    run.font.name = name
    rPr = run._element.get_or_add_rPr()
    rFonts = rPr.get_or_add_rFonts()
    rFonts.set(qn('w:eastAsia'), name)
    rFonts.set(qn('w:ascii'), name)
    rFonts.set(qn('w:hAnsi'), name)
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.bold = bold
    run.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(*color)

def set_cell_background(cell, fill_hex):
    tcPr = cell._element.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement('w:shd')
    shd.set(qn('w:val'), 'clear')
    shd.set(qn('w:color'), 'auto')
    shd.set(qn('w:fill'), fill_hex)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def set_cell_margins(cell, top=120, bottom=120, left=150, right=150):
    tcPr = cell._element.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tcMar = OxmlElement('w:tcMar')
    for m, val in [('top', top), ('bottom', bottom), ('left', left), ('right', right)]:
        node = OxmlElement(f'w:{m}')
        node.set(qn('w:w'), str(val))
        node.set(qn('w:type'), 'dxa')
        tcMar.append(node)
    tcPr.append(tcMar)

def set_table_borders(table, color="CBD5E0", sz="4"):
    tblPr = table._element.xpath('w:tblPr')
    if tblPr:
        borders = OxmlElement('w:tblBorders')
        for b_name in ['top', 'left', 'bottom', 'right', 'insideH']:
            b = OxmlElement(f'w:{b_name}')
            b.set(qn('w:val'), 'single')
            b.set(qn('w:sz'), sz)
            b.set(qn('w:space'), '0')
            b.set(qn('w:color'), color)
            borders.append(b)
        insideV = OxmlElement('w:insideV')
        insideV.set(qn('w:val'), 'none')
        borders.append(insideV)
        tblPr[0].append(borders)

def format_styled_table(table, col_widths, headers, data, align_cols=None):
    table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    set_table_borders(table)
    
    # 表头
    hdr_cells = table.rows[0].cells
    for i, title in enumerate(headers):
        hdr_cells[i].text = title
        set_cell_background(hdr_cells[i], "1A365D") # 深蓝底色
        set_cell_margins(hdr_cells[i], top=120, bottom=120, left=140, right=140)
        p = hdr_cells[i].paragraphs[0]
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
        p.runs[0].font.name = "微软雅黑"
        p.runs[0]._element.get_or_add_rPr().get_or_add_rFonts().set(qn('w:eastAsia'), "微软雅黑")
        p.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
        p.runs[0].bold = True
        p.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
        hdr_cells[i].width = col_widths[i]

    # 数据行
    for r_idx, row_data in enumerate(data):
        row_cells = table.rows[r_idx + 1].cells
        bg_color = "F7FAFC" if r_idx % 2 == 1 else "FFFFFF"
        for c_idx, val in enumerate(row_data):
            row_cells[c_idx].text = str(val)
            set_cell_background(row_cells[c_idx], bg_color)
            set_cell_margins(row_cells[c_idx], top=100, bottom=100, left=120, right=120)
            p = row_cells[c_idx].paragraphs[0]
            if align_cols and c_idx in align_cols:
                p.alignment = align_cols[c_idx]
            else:
                p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
            if len(p.runs) > 0:
                p.runs[0].font.name = "微软雅黑"
                p.runs[0]._element.get_or_add_rPr().get_or_add_rFonts().set(qn('w:eastAsia'), "微软雅黑")
                p.runs[0].font.size = Pt(9.5)
                p.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(45, 55, 72)
            row_cells[c_idx].width = col_widths[c_idx]

        "总损失函数公式：\n"
        "    L_total = L_flow + lambda_contact * L_contact + lambda_id * L_identity\n\n"
        "各分项定义：\n"
        "1. 流匹配基础损失 L_flow：\n"

        "2. 局部接触感知加权损失 L_contact：\n"
        "   L_contact = || M_contact * (v_theta - v_target) ||^2\n"
        "   以接触热力图 M_contact 为空间权重，对握手手掌、搭肩接触区域赋予 3~5 倍惩罚权重，强迫网络精细刻画接触细节。\n\n"
        "3. 身份感知保留损失 L_identity：\n"
        "   通过低频 VAE 解码器对预测图像人物面部与服装区域进行感知损失约束（LPIPS / Face-ID Cosine Similarity）。",

import os

from docx.shared import Inches, Pt, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT

# ----------------- 样式工具函数 -----------------

def set_run_font(run, name="微软雅黑", size=10, bold=False, color=(45, 55, 72), italic=False):
    run.font.name = name
    rPr = run._element.get_or_add_rPr()
    rFonts = rPr.get_or_add_rFonts()
    rFonts.set(qn('w:eastAsia'), name)
    rFonts.set(qn('w:ascii'), name)
    rFonts.set(qn('w:hAnsi'), name)
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.bold = bold
    run.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(*color)

def set_cell_background(cell, fill_hex):
    tcPr = cell._element.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement('w:shd')
    shd.set(qn('w:val'), 'clear')
    shd.set(qn('w:color'), 'auto')
    shd.set(qn('w:fill'), fill_hex)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def set_cell_margins(cell, top=100, bottom=100, left=120, right=120):
    tcPr = cell._element.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tcMar = OxmlElement('w:tcMar')
    for m, val in [('top', top), ('bottom', bottom), ('left', left), ('right', right)]:
        node = OxmlElement(f'w:{m}')
        node.set(qn('w:w'), str(val))
        node.set(qn('w:type'), 'dxa')
        tcMar.append(node)
    tcPr.append(tcMar)

def set_table_borders(table, color="CBD5E0", sz="4"):
    tblPr = table._element.xpath('w:tblPr')
    if tblPr:
        borders = OxmlElement('w:tblBorders')
        for b_name in ['top', 'left', 'bottom', 'right', 'insideH']:
            b = OxmlElement(f'w:{b_name}')
            b.set(qn('w:val'), 'single')
            b.set(qn('w:sz'), sz)
            b.set(qn('w:space'), '0')
            b.set(qn('w:color'), color)
            borders.append(b)
        insideV = OxmlElement('w:insideV')
        insideV.set(qn('w:val'), 'none')
        borders.append(insideV)
        tblPr[0].append(borders)

def add_sec_heading(doc, num_str, title_str):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(14)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)

    run_n = p.add_run(num_str + " ")

    run_t = p.add_run(title_str)
    set_run_font(run_t, name="微软雅黑", size=13, bold=True, color=(26, 54, 93))
    return p

    p = doc.add_paragraph()

    run = p.add_run(text)

def format_clean_table(table, col_widths, headers, data, align_cols=None):
    table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    set_table_borders(table)
    
    hdr_cells = table.rows[0].cells
    for i, title in enumerate(headers):
        hdr_cells[i].text = title
        set_cell_background(hdr_cells[i], "1A365D")
        set_cell_margins(hdr_cells[i], top=100, bottom=100, left=100, right=100)
        p = hdr_cells[i].paragraphs[0]
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
        p.runs[0].font.name = "微软雅黑"
        p.runs[0]._element.get_or_add_rPr().get_or_add_rFonts().set(qn('w:eastAsia'), "微软雅黑")
        p.runs[0].font.size = Pt(9.5)
        p.runs[0].bold = True
        p.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
        hdr_cells[i].width = col_widths[i]

    for r_idx, row_data in enumerate(data):
        row_cells = table.rows[r_idx + 1].cells
        bg_color = "F8FAFC" if r_idx % 2 == 1 else "FFFFFF"
        for c_idx, val in enumerate(row_data):
            row_cells[c_idx].text = str(val)
            set_cell_background(row_cells[c_idx], bg_color)
            set_cell_margins(row_cells[c_idx], top=80, bottom=80, left=100, right=100)
            p = row_cells[c_idx].paragraphs[0]
            if align_cols and c_idx in align_cols:
                p.alignment = align_cols[c_idx]
            else:
                p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
            if len(p.runs) > 0:
                p.runs[0].font.name = "微软雅黑"
                p.runs[0]._element.get_or_add_rPr().get_or_add_rFonts().set(qn('w:eastAsia'), "微软雅黑")
                p.runs[0].font.size = Pt(9)
                p.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(45, 55, 72)
            row_cells[c_idx].width = col_widths[c_idx]

def add_img(doc, img_path, caption, width=Inches(5.5)):

# ----------------- 样式辅助函数 -----------------

def set_run_font(run, name="微软雅黑", size=10, bold=False, color=(45, 55, 72), italic=False):
    run.font.name = name
    rPr = run._element.get_or_add_rPr()
    rFonts = rPr.get_or_add_rFonts()
    rFonts.set(qn('w:eastAsia'), name)
    rFonts.set(qn('w:ascii'), name)
    rFonts.set(qn('w:hAnsi'), name)
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.bold = bold
    run.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(*color)

def set_cell_background(cell, fill_hex):
    tcPr = cell._element.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement('w:shd')
    shd.set(qn('w:val'), 'clear')
    shd.set(qn('w:color'), 'auto')
    shd.set(qn('w:fill'), fill_hex)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def set_cell_margins(cell, top=100, bottom=100, left=120, right=120):
    tcPr = cell._element.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tcMar = OxmlElement('w:tcMar')
    for m, val in [('top', top), ('bottom', bottom), ('left', left), ('right', right)]:
        node = OxmlElement(f'w:{m}')
        node.set(qn('w:w'), str(val))
        node.set(qn('w:type'), 'dxa')
        tcMar.append(node)
    tcPr.append(tcMar)

def set_table_borders(table, color="CBD5E0", sz="4"):
    tblPr = table._element.xpath('w:tblPr')
    if tblPr:
        borders = OxmlElement('w:tblBorders')
        for b_name in ['top', 'left', 'bottom', 'right', 'insideH']:
            b = OxmlElement(f'w:{b_name}')
            b.set(qn('w:val'), 'single')
            b.set(qn('w:sz'), sz)
            b.set(qn('w:space'), '0')
            b.set(qn('w:color'), color)
            borders.append(b)
        insideV = OxmlElement('w:insideV')
        insideV.set(qn('w:val'), 'none')
        borders.append(insideV)
        tblPr[0].append(borders)

def add_sec_heading(doc, num_str, title_str):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(14)

    return p

def format_clean_table(table, col_widths, headers, data, align_cols=None):
    table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    set_table_borders(table)
    
    hdr_cells = table.rows[0].cells
    for i, title in enumerate(headers):
        hdr_cells[i].text = title
        set_cell_background(hdr_cells[i], "1A365D")
        set_cell_margins(hdr_cells[i], top=90, bottom=90, left=100, right=100)
        p = hdr_cells[i].paragraphs[0]
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
        p.runs[0].font.name = "微软雅黑"
        p.runs[0]._element.get_or_add_rPr().get_or_add_rFonts().set(qn('w:eastAsia'), "微软雅黑")
        p.runs[0].font.size = Pt(9.5)
        p.runs[0].bold = True
        p.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
        hdr_cells[i].width = col_widths[i]

    for r_idx, row_data in enumerate(data):
        row_cells = table.rows[r_idx + 1].cells
        bg_color = "F8FAFC" if r_idx % 2 == 1 else "FFFFFF"
        for c_idx, val in enumerate(row_data):
            row_cells[c_idx].text = str(val)
            set_cell_background(row_cells[c_idx], bg_color)
            set_cell_margins(row_cells[c_idx], top=70, bottom=70, left=100, right=100)
            p = row_cells[c_idx].paragraphs[0]
            if align_cols and c_idx in align_cols:
                p.alignment = align_cols[c_idx]
            else:
                p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
            if len(p.runs) > 0:
                p.runs[0].font.name = "微软雅黑"
                p.runs[0]._element.get_or_add_rPr().get_or_add_rFonts().set(qn('w:eastAsia'), "微软雅黑")
                p.runs[0].font.size = Pt(9)
                p.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(45, 55, 72)
            row_cells[c_idx].width = col_widths[c_idx]
